features.description: Add stable comment identity plus backwards-compatible, atomic processed-directive watermark operations to the shared directive script.
acceptance_criteria: Allowlisted directive records include immutable GitHub comment ID and createdAt fields
Legacy timestamp-only state upgrades successfully and malformed state fails loudly
Atomic updates cannot partially advance state and duplicate IDs cannot request routing twice
Processed-ID retention is bounded and existing directive security guards remain green

features.description: Integrate process-then-mark into the live shared Gate-0 preflight and prove exactly-once replay across crash points and mission profiles.
acceptance_criteria: The shared preflight marks only after durable routing evidence has landed
Every simulated crash point preserves not-yet-routed directives and prevents double routing
Timestamp anomalies and issue overlap deduplicate by comment identity
V1 legacy and namespaced mission profiles pass the same protocol tests

features.description: Wire regression tests, mutation-prove the safety guarantees, and document attended rollout verification for all four missions.
acceptance_criteria: ID omission, dedupe bypass, and mark-before-route mutations are each killed by a named test
The new test runs through the established repository test entry point
Shell syntax, focused tests, applicable lint and format gates, and diff checks pass
The attended first-live-fire checklist covers all mission profiles and retains issue 981 linkage
